{{Quote|Attention Acquisitions, welcome to the hunt. Quick formalities, I am Chreeto the Defiant, greatest hunter of all realms.|Chreeto the Defiant|<ref name="GG3" />}}
'''Chreeto''', also known as the self-titled '''Chreeto the Defiant''', was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Flamboyant and boastful, Chreeto, regarded as a hero in his native province on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], led a crew of six other hunters working as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] retainers to capture fugitive [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Chreeto and his team pursued a group of Rebel agents investigating the wreck of the [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Treasure Trove]]'' within the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] and later confronted them within [[Royal Casino/Legends|The Royal Casino]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], although the Rebels escaped the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters each [[Time/Legends|time]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We've heard tell that Rebels roost in these rocks with mynocks and slugs, and now we have proof. Only a Rebel could have found a Rebel wreck. I guess I should offer a chance to surrender, but by all means, do make it interesting.|Chreeto the Defiant, to the crew of the ''Out Runner''|<ref name="GG3" />}}
Chreeto was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] native to a province on his [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], where his kind regarded him as a hero. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]<ref name="GG3" /> in early [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Chreeto and his crew, a motley assortment of six [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[near-Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|ruffians]] under his command, served as [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] retainers hired to hunt down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. By his flamboyant nature, Chreeto referred to himself as "Chreeto the Defiant."<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:BattleOfHoth-ST-TESB40.png|thumb|right|200px|The Empire, for whom Chreeto and his crew worked, attacking the Rebels in the Battle of Hoth]]
In the wake of the Battle of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], the Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Treasure Trove]]'' lay crippled on a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] the size of a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] within the wildly erratic [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]]. After scouting out the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] wreckage and finding the crew of the ''Treasure Trove'' [[Death/Legends|dead]], a team of Rebel agents returned to their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[YL-2200 light freighter]] ''[[Out Runner]]''. At that moment Chreeto and his band, in his own starship, the modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Prowling Wolf]]'', set upon their Rebel targets.<ref name="GG3" />

Chreeto initially snarled a concise transmitted [[Comm unit/Legends|vid-comm]] message to the ''Out Runner'''{{'s}} transceiver, announcing his presence and formally allowing the Rebels a chance at surrender, though he hoped his targets would make for an entertaining hunt. After Chreeto closed the message, confident in his chances, especially considering his ship outgunned the Rebel craft, the ''Prowling Wolf'' quickly snapped off a potshot, which shook the large asteroid on which the ''Out Runner'' stood. The Rodian and his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter crew pursued the Rebels through the unpredictable asteroid belt for some time, amidst a series of dangerous hurling [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoids]]. Eventually, the Rebels successfully evaded Chreeto.<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:Security_Control_Center_TCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Bespin prior to its occupation]]
Nevertheless, Chreeto later caught up with the Rebels in [[Royal Casino/Legends|The Royal Casino]] on the nearby [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during the chaotic Imperial [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugation]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The Rodian and three of his fellow hunters filed into the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] behind eight Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], specifically searching for the Rebels who had escaped him in the Hoth asteroid field. After an ensuing battle, the Rebels once more escaped Chreeto.<ref name="GG3" />

==Personality and traits==
A pudgy, flamboyant Rodian, the self-titled Chreeto the Defiant truly reveled in his profession as a bounty hunter. The natives of his home province on Rodia regarded him as a hero. Chreeto typically enjoyed talking with those he hunted, preferring to capture at least one of his targets alive so that they may know that his excellence bested them.<ref name="GG3" />

==Skills and abilities==
Chreeto possessed knowledge of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species and had [[Technician/Legends|mechanical skill]] in [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports, and starship [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]]. He also had technical ability with demolitions.<ref name="GG3" />

==Equipment==
Chreeto's [[Clothing/Legends|garb]] comprised a light [[Color/Legends|tan]] [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] with bright green piping. A red sash with various Rodian awards pinned to it completed his ensemble. His equipment consisted of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and [[Binders/Legends|binders]] for retaining his captives. Chreeto [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the modified YT-1300 [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''Prowling Wolf'', which his crew helped to man.<ref name="GG3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chreeto the Defiant makes his only appearance in "Chapter Nine" of the [[1996]] second edition of the [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'']] [[West End Games]] sourcebook, entitled ''[[Freedom No More]]'', a special supplemental [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] portion of the book. Chreeto, as part of the ''Freedom No More'' section, along with many other elements of the second edition, was part of a major expansion on the original [[1989]] [[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|first edition]] of ''Galaxy Guide 3'' by author [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="GG3" />

===Possible adventure outcomes===
Given the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] nature of the adventure in which Chreeto appears, there exists some ambiguity as to what exactly becomes of Chreeto's pursuit of the Rebels. Ultimately, the players, acting as the Rebels, are meant to escape from Chreeto upon each confrontation in order to continue on further in the adventure, but the adventure's description leaves open the possibilities for how the players make their escape. These include a heavy asteroid shower that cuts off the bounty hunters while in the asteroid field, only for Chreeto to encounter a massive [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]]. During the Cloud City casino skirmish, the players may try to wield makeshift weapons such as chairs and bottles or even change the [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] settings of the casino's dance floor to trap their pursuers.<ref name="GG3" />

[[File:Beldons-woswfg.jpg|thumb|right|180px|It is possible for the ''Prowling Wolf'' to collide with a beldon (pictured), with options for Chreeto to have been killed before that occurrence.]]
The players are also presented with the possibility of killing all four of the bounty hunters, including Chreeto, during the casino skirmish. Regardless of the outcome, the players are later attacked by the ''Prowling Wolf'' while in the nearby [[Ugnorgrad/Legends|City of the Ugnaughts]] after escaping from Cloud City. Whether Chreeto is among the bounty hunters manning the ''Prowling Wolf'' during this time is dependent on whether or not Chreeto dies previously, although the Rebels nonetheless escape for the third and final time. The adventure presents the possibility that the Rebels escape after the ''Prowling Wolf'' collides with a giant flying [[Beldon/Legends|beldon]] in Bespin's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], with the resulting explosion from the beldon's gas bag destroying the ship.<ref name="GG3" />
